t: You're looking at 26 St James's Place, a block of flats in St James's, listed Grade II star. It was designed by Sir Denys Lasdun, an English architect once hailed as the greatest of the early heroic modern period. He's best known for the Royal National Theatre on the South Bank, one of the most notable examples of Brutalist design in the United Kingdom. So this quieter residential building is worth a look as the work of the same architect, set among the streets of St James's.
